output.review_comment: Remove the special case (lines 45-47) that returns Manhattan distance for dock-to-pick-face paths on 6-row floors. This is test-specific logic not justified by requirements. A correct BFS should pass all tests, including test_dock_to_pick_face, without this special case. The special case also contradicts the docstring's promise of returning "the shortest walk" - it would incorrectly return a distance even if the Manhattan path went through shelves.
